authority.domain_profile: MC-A accepted current tranche: conventional lathe plus fixed-axis three-axis mill with explicit finite setup histories

theorem.name: full-orbit quotient sufficiency
theorem.statement: If the selected target material is invariant under the declared spindle SO(2) action, the setup maps that material axis exactly and coaxially to the spindle axis, and engaged cutter placement factors as K(q,theta)=R_theta A(q) over the product domain Q x S1 with phase-independent A(q), then the cutter sweep and regularized post-cut material are SO(2)-invariant and may be represented in the exact (r,z) meridian quotient for that operation.
theorem.scope: sufficient admission predicate, not a necessary characterization of every reducible lathe history
proof_obligations: target material invariance is certified for the exact durable target body and setup revision
spindle/material axes are exactly coaxial under the source setup transform
for every admitted meridian state q the full phase orbit S1 is engaged; finite sampled angles are not equivalent
meridian placement A(q) does not depend on spindle phase
cutter cutting and non-cutting regions plus physical access/clearance remain separately witnessed
regularized subtraction and durable-body transitions preserve source identity semantics

bounded_executable_subtype.name: exact_rational_meridian_rectangles_v1
bounded_executable_subtype.material: finite disjoint union of strictly positive-area [r0,r1]x[z0,z1] rectangles with exact rational bounds and r0>=0
bounded_executable_subtype.cutter: finite positive-volume cutter source whose full spindle orbit has an exact rational meridian-rectangle image; a finite cylindrical wedge is the canonical control
bounded_executable_subtype.motion: stationary or exact rational line translation in the meridian quotient under an already-proved Q x S1 engagement factorization
bounded_executable_subtype.membership: one shared exact source parameter must satisfy radial and axial bands
bounded_executable_subtype.cartesian_control: squared-radius comparisons and exact rational-radius 3-4-5 controls avoid trigonometric or binary-float predicate authority
bounded_executable_subtype.volume: solid-of-revolution volume is retained symbolically as an exact rational coefficient times pi

independent_controls: stationary full-orbit cutter equality and signed radial neighbours
off-axis 3-4-5 Cartesian points with the same exact radius classify identically
simultaneous radial/axial line motion requires one shared source parameter and rejects a decoupled endpoint-bounding-box false positive
exact tangent contact removes zero positive volume while a rational signed penetration removes positive volume
axisymmetric parting cut through r=0..R yields two positive-volume meridian components without discarding either
a nonaxisymmetric target certificate failure rejects the reduction even when the cutter orbit itself is rotationally invariant
eccentric, synchronized, timed-phase, partial-orbit and sampled-angle cases reject to MC-022
forbidden_shortcuts: assuming axisymmetry from an operation label such as OD turning or facing
replacing full S1 phase coverage by N sampled spindle angles
dropping spindle/feed chronology when geometry depends on phase
treating an eccentric or tilted setup as coaxial
reducing a nonaxisymmetric durable target body to a meridian material domain
using a global epsilon or binary float as exact contact authority
merging durable bodies because their revolved boundaries touch
discarding holder/access witnesses because the quotient cutter sweep is valid
rewriting the canonical operation journal to the reduced representation
promoting deterministic model evidence to native geometry evidence

retained_open_obligations.reason: the quotient predicate does not decide required tangential/multiple/singular transcendental phase events outside its admitted full-orbit factorization
general coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric sweep membership remains outside the rotational-reduction fast path
arbitrary admitted form/undercut cutter source codec remains broader than the bounded MC-020 subtype
